newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares forge new record low.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares forge new record low.

text.p: Shares in crisis-ridden information technology group Olivetti resumed their downward path on the Italian bourse early, exploring new record lows after flattening out briefly last week.
Olivetti ordinary shares were 4.00 percent down at 550 lire (36 cents) by 1005 GMT after touching 542 lire earlier, the lowest they have ever been.

Traders cited continued confusion and lack of clarity over the state of the company's finances as depressing the share further and noted news over the weekend that magistrates in the town of Ivrea, where Olivetti has its headquarters, had started a preliminary probe into the group. ($ = 1525 Italian Lire)
